g.text: Managers agree using Raft: a majority (quorum) must be reachable
Swarm defaults (docker info): heartbeat every 1 s; election after 10 missed ticks (~10 s).
No heartbeat for ~10 s (Election Tick 10) -> a follower calls an election; a new leader needs
Without a majority the cluster stops accepting changes (this prevents "split brain").
quorum = floor(N/2) + 1. 4 managers tolerate no more failures
so use an ODD number: 3, 5 or 7.
